datum_text: model mean sea level (EOT20); not a chart datum
changes: Modified: the harmonic constants of the EOT20 cell nearest each break were extracted, amplitudes converted from cm to m, and tide heights are computed from them by this app.
citation: Hart-Davis, M. G., Piccioni, G., Dettmering, D., Schwatke, C., Passaro, M. and Seitz, F. (2021): EOT20: a global ocean tide model from multi-mission satellite altimetry. Earth System Science Data 13, 3869-3884, https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-13-3869-2021. Data: Hart-Davis, M. et al. (2021), EOT20 - A global Empirical Ocean Tide model from multi-mission satellite altimetry, SEANOE, https://doi.org/10.17882/79489.
grid: 1/8 degree regular latitude-longitude grid (cell centres as listed)
selection: Nearest grid cell to the break (spots.json latitude/longitude) at which every constituent is defined (EOT20 masks land and cells it does not resolve).
convention: h(t) = sum f * A * cos(V0 + u - G), V0 + u for Greenwich (UTC)
